name: Watashi wa Korosu Switch Desu.
original_name: 私は人殺スイッチです。
source:
If you push me, someone will die. 
This is what i am.
And being pushed is what I desire most. 
Please push me and love me!
translation:
If you push me, someone will die. 
This is what i am.
And being pushed is what I desire most. 
Please push me and love me!
